items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: the personnel in that band was Luther West, Roy Milton... Luther West, alto, Pete Bailey on tenor and Roy Walker trumpet and me on trombone.

ctx.x: Per chance, do you remember the personnel in that band?
Yes, the personnel in that band was Luther West, Roy Milton--

items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Rene has just about made up his mind that he's going to go on back to Tulsa with you to join this band.

ctx.x: One or the other. He's from Tulsa too. He came here and West, they weren't exactly the same classmates, very close, but West went to Xavier in New Orleans.
By the way, so Luther would play with you just intermittently and go back to school?
